crossRefs.note: The sons of Naphtali: Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem.
The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, Shallum, and the sons of Bilhah.

people.name: Guni
people.line: Son of Naphtali, grandson of Jacob.

people.name: Jahzeel
people.line: Son of Naphtali, grandson of Jacob, and a clan leader.

people.name: Naphtali
people.line: Son of Jacob, founder of the tribe of Naphtali.

translations.web: The sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites; of Guni, the family of the Gunites;
translations.bsb: These were the descendants of Naphtali by their clans: The Jahzeelite clan from Jahzeel, the Gunite clan from Guni,
translations.kjv: Of the sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites: of Guni, the family of the Gunites:
